title: Supply Chain Delays
summary: This story details how supply chain disruptions increased material lead times from 10 to 16 weeks, putting multiple projects at risk. The owner used a two-pronged approach involving factory partial shipments and field mechanic overtime to keep projects on schedule and maintain customer satisfaction.

key_points.text: Material lead times increased from 10 to 16 weeks
Owner informed customers of bad news
Owner worked with factory to implement partial shipments
Partial shipments allowed mechanics to start assembly immediately
Coordinated with field mechanics to put in significant overtime
Kept all projects on track and maintained customer satisfaction

differences: The initial increase in material lead times was stated as 10 to 16 weeks in the Amazon prep, but as 12 to 16 weeks in the Tanium prep and Tiktok prep.

related.title: Otis Project Management
related.why: This note details the owner's role as a project manager at Otis, which is the company where the supply chain issue occurred.
